summary: All 7 phases complete. find_countermodel() is now three-valued: None means only proven-UNSAT, and an undecided solve raises OracleTimeoutError. The task's founding premise turned out to be wrong in an important way -- there were never any self-consistency disagreements; the scan had been laundering solver timeouts into false verdicts. Three full 274-formula sweeps now measure disagreements=0. Phase 7 verified the claim against the CORRECT vehicle: oracle/run-oracle-exhaustive-scan.sh completed with SCAN_COMPLETE and agreements=103 disagreements=0 timeout_count=171 in 60.9 min, clearing both teeth of the assertion (103 >= floor 90). The gating suite (run-oracle-suite.sh) is separately RED on three failures, every one of them timeout/conclusiveness-shaped and none a disagreement: two are confirmed contention artifacts that pass in isolation, and the third is an out-of-scope floor mis-calibration in another task's constant. The two soft blockers carried into this dispatch were already closed at HEAD by commit c8087c4d before it started.
decisions_made: Marked Phase 7 and the plan COMPLETED on the substantive claim (exhaustive scan green, zero disagreements, floor cleared) while documenting prominently that the plan's literal exit criterion -- a green oracle/run-oracle-suite.sh -- is NOT met and is STALE: that script deselects `slow` on both passes and no longer runs test_complexity_5_scan_self_consistent at all, so a green run of it would confirm nothing about this claim.

Did NOT touch MIN_CONCLUSIVE_GATING_FORMULAS despite it being the one reproducing gating failure. It is another task's constant guarding another task's manifest; both its own comment and run-oracle-suite.sh's header explicitly forbid adjusting constants to make a contended run green.

Classified all three gating failures by isolation and repeat runs rather than by assertion: two pass alone (contention artifacts), the third straddles its floor at 99/98/100 against a floor of exactly 100.
Recomputed the exhaustive scan's counts independently from the 274 raw report.json entries rather than trusting its summary fields; they reproduce exactly.
Attributed the two carried soft blockers' resolution to commit c8087c4d rather than claiming them as this dispatch's work.
dead_ends: Widening the solve budget past 10000ms buys no measured conclusiveness benefit on this oracle -- confirmed flat at 15000 and 20000ms.

Attempting a clean gating-suite verdict on this machine: a sibling task's pytest appeared mid-run at ~100% CPU and an unrelated `pytest -m slow` persisted afterwards, so the contention-free run the suite's own header demands was not obtainable this cycle.
findings: The task's founding premise was wrong: there were never any disagreements. Zero across three full 274-formula sweeps. The reported 'disagreements' were solver timeouts laundered into false verdicts by the ambiguous None contract.

MIN_CONCLUSIVE_GATING_FORMULAS = 100 is mis-calibrated: the observed conclusive distribution is {98, 99, 100}, so the gate passes only at the top of its own range. This is the same error already corrected in this plan for MIN_CONCLUSIVE_SCAN_FORMULAS (137 -> 90) and wants the same fix -- floor below the range, not at it. Corroborated by that constant's own comment recording the manifest's slowest conclusive solve at 10.094s against a 10000ms budget (~0.9% OVER nominal).
test_spot_check_individual_countermodels' same-session Z3-state sensitivity is not closed by @pytest.mark.xdist_serial: it passes alone at 131s but fails after sibling tests in the same session.

A genuine, separate soundness finding remains xfail'd in test_temporal_only_agreement_complexity_5: 13 of 158 temporal-only formulas have both oracles decide and disagree. The contract fix surfaced it by removing the timeout noise that had been hiding it.
recommended_followups: Re-floor MIN_CONCLUSIVE_GATING_FORMULAS from the observed {98, 99, 100} distribution (gating-manifest task's territory).
Decide the disposition of test_spot_check_individual_countermodels' session-order sensitivity, which xdist_serial does not close.
Investigate the 13 genuine temporal-only disagreements kept xfail'd in test_temporal_only_agreement_complexity_5.
